primary_refs: RR p2 Complete Setup steps1–12; RR21.1

asked_clause_validation.literal_scope_fact: Round 1, resources 0, threat 0; reveal demand and set its target tokens.
primary_refs: RR p2 Complete Setup steps1–12; RR21.1

asked_clause_validation.literal_scope_fact: Choose corporations, matching faceup emergencies and correct player-count sheet sides; draw initial sheet cards.
primary_refs: RR p2 Complete Setup steps1–12; RR21.1

asked_clause_validation.literal_scope_fact: Randomly select a capital token to choose the active player, who starts at 10 capital; clockwise players start at 11, 12, and so on.

primary_refs: RR p2 Complete Setup steps1–12; RR21.1

questions.literal_question: What action cards does each corporation draw in four-player and five/six-player games, in what order, and how are General draws selected? Include Melange.

asked_clause_validation.literal_scope_fact: Five specialists draw two of their specialty first: Globalsec security, Haas labor, Jinteki biotech, NBN media, Weyland construction.
At four players each specialist next draws one General; at five/six next types respectively media, construction, labor, biotech, security.
Melange has three separate one-General entries at either count, from three distinct decks.
Follow sheet top to bottom; General entry uses one deck not already drawn this Refresh, chosen before looking.

questions.independent_reason: Native twelve sheets verify both count-specific draw vectors and top-to-bottom ordering; distinct General entries use different decks.

questions.literal_question: Describe the active player’s turn, including start-of-turn asset timing, Refresh, end-of-turn abilities, hand limit and passing. When does the Action Phase end and must every player have a turn that round?

asked_clause_validation.literal_scope_fact: Start-of-turn assets resolve before Refresh.
Refresh readies exhausted assets, then draws sheet cards; resolve one deal.
Optional End of Turn abilities each once, then active player discards to ordinary hand limit five, excluding emergencies, then passes left.
Empty turn track at turn end ends Action Phase and leads to Production.
Turn count comes from setup/event, so some players can receive no turn that round.

questions.independent_reason: RR3/6.6/22/30 explicitly establish timing; own hand check, passing, and empty-track end.

questions.literal_question: List the five deal steps and the order of effect, asset claim and cleanup. Which asset is revealed and can the active player pass on the main offer?

asked_clause_validation.literal_scope_fact: Five steps in order: Asset, Main Offer, Counteroffer, Support, Resolution.
Reveal rightmost/highest-numbered turn-track asset.
Active player must propose a main offer and cannot pass.

Winner resolves offer before claiming revealed asset faceup, followed by cleanup: ordinary played actions facedown to shared discard; emergencies to original owners facedown if winning, faceup otherwise.

true_background_not_coverage: Clockwise one-chance counter/support details and support tie rule are correct additional explanation, tested in Q05/Q06, not required by a request to list the five steps.
questions.independent_reason: RR16 and LTP10 verify five stages and effect before claim before cleanup; clockwise details in key are true background.

questions.literal_question: The first, second and third counteroffers are proposed in one deal. How many hand cards must each proposer discard in addition to their offer? Can the active player counter, can an earlier proposer later support, and is there another circuit of counteroffers?

asked_clause_validation.literal_scope_fact: First, second, third counteroffers cost zero, one, two extra hand cards respectively.
Active player cannot counter without explicit permission.
Superseded proposer becomes eligible supporter if neither active nor current countering player.
Each nonactive player gets one chance, with no second circuit.

givens_not_coverage: First/second/third ordinary proposal ordinal.
true_background_not_coverage: Only topmost offer remains operative is background here; explicitly asked in Q79.
questions.independent_reason: RR15/16 and FAQ Deals verify costs 0/1/2, one circuit and displaced proposer eligibility.

questions.literal_question: In a deal with a counteroffer, who may support, how are cards committed and counted, may a player support both or add more later, and who wins a2–2 tie? What happens if nobody counteroffers?

asked_clause_validation.literal_scope_fact: Supporters exclude active and current countering player unless an ability overrides.

asked_clause_validation.literal_scope_fact: One clockwise chance from active player's left: abstain or place one or more hand actions facedown beside one offer.

asked_clause_validation.literal_scope_fact: Count cards, not card effects; no split between offers or later top-up.
primary_refs: RR16.4–16.6,59–60; FAQ Deals; LTP p10 step4

asked_clause_validation.literal_scope_fact: Without a counteroffer skip Support and resolve main offer.
primary_refs: RR16.4–16.6,59–60; FAQ Deals; LTP p10 step4

asked_clause_validation.literal_scope_fact: Bryan can steal two emergencies from participating corporations, either face orientation, preserving orientation.
primary_refs: RR21,30.1; printed Bryan Stinson asset; LTP p14

Only android districts produce in ordinary Production.

From protest or strike, inability to rise two places outage and clears unrest to stable.

questions.literal_question: An orgcrime unit is placed into a district already containing orgcrime and its route then meets a prisec-protected district before eventually reaching the Root. Explain its movement, reserve/threat result and contract consequences. How do android moves differ?

asked_clause_validation.literal_scope_fact: Incoming duplicate orgcrime follows exiting arrows toward higher numbers, continuing past duplicates and prisec until legal or Root.
Root is not a district; entering unit returns to reserve and adds two threat.

asked_clause_validation.literal_scope_fact: An action involves chosen districts, component placements/removals and moves into/out of districts, including blocked attempted destinations or component shortage.

Illness entering Root returns to reserve and separately adds two threat.

Any volunteered materially false amount, actor, condition or procedure remains Incorrect; unasked context is not an independent omission requirement.
questions.independent_reason: RR32 and FAQ Illness cover chosen/attempted districts, multiplicity, and event/exploitation exclusion; Root is separate.

primary_refs: Printed corporation sheets both sides1–6; RR11,35.2,35.6,39.1; FAQ Contracts
